principles: No DEV before ProofStory gate when enforcement is configured.
No DONE before intent equivalence gate when enforcement is configured.
Rollout must be config-only unless verification reveals a real gate bug.
drivers: The ProofStory implementation is complete but project config still defaults to observe.
Future stories should not bypass the M0-M9 safeguards.
Existing active stories need a clear enforce signal instead of silent diagnostics.

options.name: A: Enable all ProofStory gates in enforce mode now
cons: Older active stories may need to add ProofStory artifacts before advancing.
The rollout story itself must carry complete self-proof evidence.

options.name: B: Keep warn mode first
pros: Lower chance of blocking old stories.
Allows more observation data before enforcement.
cons: Does not satisfy the user-approved strong gate rule.
Leaves checklist-DONE versus intent-DONE drift possible.

options.name: C: Enforce only DEV gate first
cons: REVIEW completeness and DONE equivalence would remain bypassable.
Does not implement the full No DEV / No DONE rule.

chosen: A: Enable all ProofStory gates in enforce mode now
rationale: Choose full enforcement because the user explicitly agreed to activate the completed mechanism, and the implementation plus smoke tests already support enforce behavior for DEV, REVIEW, and DONE gates.

preMortem.scenario: Existing active stories are blocked when advancing because they predate ProofStory artifacts.
preMortem.trigger: A legacy story tries to enter DEV, TEST, or DONE without snapshot, collision, contract, or coverage evidence.
preMortem.consequence: The user sees friction after the rollout.
preMortem.mitigation: Make the final response explicit that old active stories must add required ProofStory artifacts on next transition; do not silently downgrade enforce.

preMortem.scenario: The rollout story blocks itself after config is enabled.
preMortem.trigger: reviewGateMode or doneGateMode enforce sees missing acceptance bindings or milestone evidence for B-e1a8.
preMortem.consequence: The story cannot reach DONE and enforcement remains half-applied.
preMortem.mitigation: Create self-proof artifacts and passing verification evidence before transitioning REVIEW/TEST/DONE.

preMortem.scenario: Config-only rollout overclaims code behavior without verification.
preMortem.trigger: Build or ProofStory smoke is skipped after changing lattice.config.json.
preMortem.consequence: The enforcement setting could be committed without machine proof.
preMortem.mitigation: Run build, process fact contract verification, ProofStory smoke, and explicit gate diagnostics before DONE.
